title: Python: rekey on member removal
description: Trigger rekeying when member is removed
close_reason: GroupsCollectionResource.rekey() rotates master_secret/salt, increments key_epoch, drops removed member, 1h retired-epoch grace (REKEY_GRACE_S=3600). GroupsRemoveResource calls rekey when a collection is attached. pytest tests/coap/test_groups_rekey.py::test_rekey_on_member_removal passed.
